scoring.A: Direct natural expression using the canonical 1,001 concepts plus ordinary grammar, morphology, and numeration.
scoring.B: Successful pre-frozen productive composition using only canonical lexical concepts and already-authorized productive mechanisms, with semantic equivalence required where safety-critical.
scoring.C: Genuine failure: neither direct expression nor a frozen admissible productive route can complete the task.

evidence_sequence: Materialize and freeze the 512-task battery and every creditable productive route with no score.
Record exact freeze commit and battery blob.
Write result without editing battery, vocabulary bands, or productive repair authorities.
Verify byte identity and stop before any repair.
scientific_boundary: Internal prospective benchmark only; not third-party learner validation.
